patches.name: Last.fm scrobbling
patches.description: Scrobbles the tracks you play to Last.fm and shows what is playing on your profile. Log in with your Last.fm account in Settings > Glassworks > Last.fm.

patches.name: Pill navigation bar
patches.description: Replaces the bottom bar with floating glass pills for the mini player and the tabs, with the screen content blurred behind them. Style them in Settings > Glassworks: frosted or liquid glass, one or two pills, their shape, size and tint (including one from the album art), a compact mini player, and hidden, reordered or separate tabs.
